subject: Rename systemd files and content to valkey from redis (#234)
reason: The change only renames example systemd service unit files in utils/ (systemd-redis_server.service to systemd-valkey_server.service and the multiple-servers template) and rewords their comments, descriptions, and example paths from redis to valkey. These are packaging/documentation artifacts that are never compiled into or read by valkey-server, the tools, or any test path; no command, reply, replication, persistence, or config behaviour changes, so no scenario can reach it.
